newsitem.title: USA: Glickman expected to stay on at Ag.
newsitem.headline: Glickman expected to stay on at Ag.

text.p: Agriculture Secretary Dan Glickman is among a number of Clinton administration Cabinet positions expected to stay on for President Clinton's second term, White House officials said.

Glickman's reappointment is expected to be announced Friday by the president along with that of Education Secretary Dick Riley, Interior Secretary Bruce Babbitt and Veterans Affairs Secretary Jesse Brown, officials said.
